products_head.title: Practical tools, ready to use
products_head.text: From cloud management and market research to desktop automation, choose the tool that fits your workflow. Contact us on LINE to ask about a free trial.

products.name: Cloud Attendance Calendar
products.text: Clock-ins, leave, overtime and assigned tasks in one calendar. Includes GPS or workplace-network clock-in, overtime estimates and support for seven languages.
products.detail: Employees clock in from their phones, while leave, overtime and assigned tasks appear in a shared calendar. Managers can see who is working and review attendance and overtime calculations at month-end.
products.features:
Mobile clock-in | Use GPS or the workplace network without buying a clock-in terminal
Online requests | Employees submit leave and overtime requests on their phones; approved requests appear in the calendar
Overtime estimates | Calculate weekday and rest-day overtime using Taiwan labor rules
Assigned tasks | See who is responsible for each task and when it is due
Seven languages | Supports Chinese, English, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Thai, Japanese and more
App-like access | Add the website to your phone's home screen without installing a separate app
products.fit:
Shops and factories with shifts, field staff or part-time employees
Teams with staff who speak different languages
Businesses replacing paper attendance sheets and leave forms

products.name: Cloud Inventory Management
products.text: Manage purchasing, sales, stocktaking and inventory in one place. Track costs and gross profit by product and sales channel.
products.detail: Bring purchasing, sales, stocktaking and inventory into one system. Calculate costs and gross profit for each transaction, then compare performance across products and sales channels.
products.features:
Multiple sales channels | Keep Shopee, your website and physical-store records separate or review them together
Automatic stock updates | Purchases and sales update inventory without daily spreadsheet edits
Costs and gross profit | See how much each product and channel earns
Stocktaking | Adjust inventory using actual stock counts
Export reports | Export to Excel for reconciliation and accounting
products.fit:
Shopee and other online sellers
Small businesses with both an online shop and a physical store
Teams struggling to reconcile spreadsheet inventory

products.name: US Stock Opportunity Radar
products.text: Explore six research lists and compare US companies by valuation, financial quality, growth and momentum. Sector filters and stock details help narrow your research.

trial.title: Add us on LINE for free access
trial.text: US Stock Opportunity Radar is free to use. Message us on LINE for access details and instructions.
trial.steps:
Add us on LINE
Send “Free access — US Stock Opportunity Radar”
Receive access details and instructions
trial.note: US Stock Opportunity Radar is free to use, with no three-day trial limit or automatic charges.

products.detail: Spend less time looking up financial figures one stock at a time. The radar organizes price and fundamental data into six lists, with industry-relative scores for valuation, quality, growth and momentum. Filter the lists, then open a stock page to review its selection reasons, financial metrics and one-year price history.
products.features:
Six research lists | Explore low-P/E opportunities, composite scores, quality pullbacks, analyst sentiment, stable dividends and momentum
Industry-relative scores | Compare valuation, financial quality, growth and momentum within the same sector, alongside a composite score
Sector and market-cap filters | Narrow your research by sector and minimum market capitalization
Stock details and selection reasons | Review P/E, cash flow, revenue growth, analyst data and why a stock appears on a list
Price history and performance | View one-year trends, 52-week ranges and returns over several periods
Scheduled post-market updates | Run daily updates while the service is active, or start an update manually and check the data timestamp
products.fit:
People building a US stock research list using consistent criteria
Researchers comparing valuation and financial quality within an industry
People who want fundamentals, price trends and selection reasons in one place
products.notice: Data is not real-time. Completeness and update times depend on the data sources. Scores and lists are research and screening tools, not investment advice, and do not guarantee returns.

products.name: Shopee Auto Bump
products.text: Choose products and their order in your desktop browser, then automate product bumping. Scheduling, manual runs and activity logs reduce repetitive Seller Centre tasks.
products.detail: Let a browser extension handle repeated product-bumping tasks. Sign in to Shopee Seller Centre, select your products, arrange their order and turn on automation. The extension schedules runs based on available slots and previous bump times, with the next run, daily totals and activity logs visible at a glance.
products.features:
Product selection and ordering | Search for products, select them and adjust their order
Rotation and slot filling | Work through the selected list and rotate products when it exceeds the batch size
Scheduling and wait settings | Track bump times and set intervals for the next run
Manual controls | Run once to check the result, or use the start/pause switch
Status and activity logs | Review the next run, last run, daily totals and success or error messages
License activation and trial | Activate with a license key and ask about a three-day free trial; contact us for device-binding changes
products.fit:
Shopee sellers who regularly bump products
Stores that want to rotate a larger product list in a set order
Users who can keep their computer awake, browser open and Seller Centre signed in
products.notice: Requires desktop Chrome or Edge, extension installation and a computer that stays awake with the browser open. This is not an official Shopee service. Automated actions may lead to warnings or account restrictions; assess the risks and follow platform rules. Search rankings and sales are not guaranteed.

faq.q: Does a lower price mean lower quality?
faq.a: Savings come from our development process. AI handles repetitive coding tasks, while we focus on requirements, testing and quality checks before delivery.
We reuse proven components from our existing products and use AI-assisted development to get a working version ready sooner.

faq.q: Can I request changes after launch?
faq.a: Ongoing adjustments are available through a maintenance plan. Contact us on LINE for minor changes; larger features are quoted for your approval first.
Cloud products use servers with encrypted connections, separate company data and regular backups. Custom projects can also run on your own server or cloud account.

faq.q: Can I try a product first?
faq.a: Yes. Paid products offer a free trial, and US Stock Opportunity Radar is free to use. For custom projects, we can show a demonstration after the initial discussion.
